zh: 某件商品在第 i 次（从 0 开始）被买时，它已经被前面每次购买各减了 1，收益是 max(0, 初值−i)，只与它的初值和购买次序有关。
越早买损失越小，所以应该先买初值大的：交换一对“小的先买、大的后买”不会让总收益变少。
把积分降序排序，第 i 个贡献 max(0, a[i]−i)，求和；收益不会为负，所以全部买下也无妨；总和用 64 位。
en: When an item is bought as the i-th purchase (0-based), every earlier purchase has already reduced it by 1, so it earns max(0, initial−i), which depends only on its initial value and its position.
Earlier purchases lose less, so buy larger values first: swapping a smaller-earlier, larger-later pair never decreases the total.
Sort the points in descending order and add max(0, a[i]−i) for each i; gains are never negative, so buying everything is fine. Use a 64-bit total.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the initial points in descending order; the i-th purchase (0-based) earns max(0, a[i]−i); sum these gains.

## Proof of correctness

The gain from buying an item with initial value v at step i depends only on v and i. For an earlier step i and a later step j with initial values x≥y, max(0,x−i)+max(0,y−j)≥max(0,y−i)+max(0,x−j), because the same time loss leaves the larger initial value with no smaller gain. Swapping inversions never lowers the total, so descending order is optimal; gains are non-negative, so putting the unbought items at the end does not reduce the total.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space; the total points need 64 bits.
